test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about River Ganga?

options.text: The water level of River Ganga never depends on monsoon and climatic condition of the Himalaya.
River Ganga and its river basin support lots of wonderful wildlife, particularly river dolphins, otters, freshwater turtles, and gharials.
River Ganga flows from the Himalayas all the way to the Bay of Bengal.
River Ganga in India is more than 2500 km long and is the most populated river basin in the world.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The water level of River Ganga never depends on monsoon and climatic condition of the Himalaya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 1** is incorrect because the water level of River Ganga does depend on monsoon and the climatic conditions of the Himalayas.
 
• **River Ganga** and its river basin support a diverse range of wildlife, including river dolphins, otters, freshwater turtles, and gharials.
 
• **River Ganga** flows from the Himalayas all the way to the Bay of Bengal.
 
• **River Ganga** in India is more than 2500 km long and is the most populated river basin in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ganga River is considered sacred in Hinduism and is worshipped as the goddess Ganga.
 
• The river is crucial for irrigation, drinking water, and transportation for millions of people living in its basin.
 
• Several initiatives have been launched to clean and protect the river, including the Namami Gange Programme by the Government of India.
 
• Despite its importance, the Ganga faces significant pollution challenges from industrial discharge, domestic sewage, and religious offerings.
